comments.text: I would like to take this precious moment to thank you and your team for the great and fabulous efforts you took to bringing out this country from darkness into light for me and other  viewers.  The information is very interesting, amazing, informative, educative, and stimulating as well to know about Cuba. I have been viewing many of your posts on YouTube and kindly keep the good work going for many of us cannot visit many countries we are looking at for one or more reasons. Thank you! I am LP Hari from USA. 09/03/2026.
